_comment: SAAX Protocol — Supplier payment-rail registrations. Each indexed supplier MAY advertise payment rails here. This file is the Day 5 test fixture AND the shape the live index will emit on Day 7 (wallet wiring swaps only the data source, not the router). A supplier that advertises neither rail is routed 'unsupported' and excluded from matches — the router NEVER silently sends a rail the supplier did not accept. payTo addresses must pass basic format validation before any payment payload is constructed.

mpp.note: requires fiat rails or Stripe-native settlement
